reason: I already pay an admin to put receipts in the spreadsheet. Yes, she's always behind, but she gets there, and I'm not adding another subscription to replace a job someone already has on payroll.
objection: Renovation receipts are messy: handwritten nota from material shops, half-cropped transfer screenshots, cash to workers with no paper at all. I don't believe a bot gets those right, and if my admin has to check every row anyway, I'm paying twice.
would_change_my_mind: If my admin ran the free 40 on a real week of our chats and it saved her most of a day with almost no corrections, plus caught a duplicate payment we would have missed, I'd pay for it.
